teamAnalyzer.title: Team
teamAnalyzer.subtitle: Builder
teamAnalyzer.generateDesc: Choose a starter Pokémon and RotomDex will generate a balanced team for your game version.
teamAnalyzer.atLeastOneTeam: You must have at least one team!
teamAnalyzer.generationError: Error during team generation. Please try again.
teamAnalyzer.analysisError: Error during analysis. Please try again later.
teamAnalyzer.casualPrompt:
You are a friendly Pokémon Professor. Analyze this team for the game '{{game}}' in a VERY SIMPLE way.
Team: {{team}}.

Provide a short and encouraging analysis focused on:
1. Team 'Vibe': Is it a balanced or fun team?
2. Big Obstacles: Which Gym Leader or Elite Four member should they be a bit more careful with? (Only the most important ones).
3. A flash tip: A move or a Pokémon to add to be safe.

Use simple language, no technical terms like 'EVs', 'IVs' or 'Sweeper'. Respond in English.
teamAnalyzer.competitivePrompt:
You are a competitive Pokémon analyst (Try-harder). Analyze this team for the game '{{game}}' in an EXTREMELY DETAILED and TECHNICAL way.
Team: {{team}}.

Provide a brutal and in-depth analysis on:
1. Specific Matchups: Analyze the coverage against EVERY Gym Leader, Elite Four, and the Champion. Who wins and who loses?
2. Core and Synergies: Analyze cross-type weaknesses and if fundamental roles are missing (Wall, Sweeper, Pivot).
3. Pro Optimization: Suggest specific move sets, held items, and possible substitutions to maximize the win-rate.

Use technical terms (STAB, Coverage, Check, Counter). Be critical if the team has obvious flaws. Respond in English.
teamAnalyzer.analysisError: Error during team analysis. Please try again.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.welcome: Welcome to PokéBook. Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we handle your data.

section1.title: 1. Data Collected
section1.content: We only collect data necessary for the service to function: email, display name, and game preferences (Pokédex, Shiny Hunting).

section2.title: 2. Data Usage
section2.content: Your data is used exclusively to synchronize your progress across your devices via Firebase.

section3.title: 3. Third Party Services
section3.content: We use Firebase (Google) for authentication and the database. PokéAPI is used to retrieve Pokémon data.
